title: Onego abed gi Yesu
stanzas: Onego abed gi Yesu, Ok anyal wuotho kenda. Ka Yesu obedo buta Anyalo yudo teko.
Onego abed gi Yesu, Kuom Yie mara e chunya; Wechene ohoyo chunya, Ka gimiya tekone.
Onego abed gi Yesu, E ngimana duto te;Kata an e temruok moro, kata e parruok moro.
Onego abed gi Yesu E yorena duto te;Eka an anyalo chopo E dala mosingonwa.
chorus: Eka chunya ok noluor (ok noluor); Anadhi ka modwaro, (modwaro);Anadhi mapiyo piyo, Kotelona e wang`yo.
